mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_index_generation ( generation_id, job_id, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, embedding_config_id, chunking_config_hash, chunk_artifact_key, chunk_artifact_checksum, chunk_count, status, worker_token, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{generationId}, #{jobId}, #{workspaceId}, #{documentId}, #{versionNo}, #{indexInputRevision}, #{embeddingConfigId}, #{chunkingConfigHash}, #{chunkArtifactKey}, #{chunkArtifactChecksum}, #{chunkCount}, #{status}, #{workerToken}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, generation_id, job_id, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, embedding_config_id, chunking_config_hash, chunk_artifact_key, chunk_artifact_checksum, chunk_count, status, worker_token, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_generation WHERE generation_id = #{generationId}

SELECT id, generation_id, job_id, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, embedding_config_id, chunking_config_hash, chunk_artifact_key, chunk_artifact_checksum, chunk_count, status, worker_token, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_generation WHERE generation_id = #{generationId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, generation_id, job_id, workspace_id, document_id, version_no, index_input_revision, embedding_config_id, chunking_config_hash, chunk_artifact_key, chunk_artifact_checksum, chunk_count, status, worker_token, created_at, updated_at FROM knowledge_index_generation WHERE generation_id IN
#{generationId}

SELECT generation.id, generation.generation_id, generation.job_id, generation.workspace_id, generation.document_id, generation.version_no, generation.index_input_revision, generation.embedding_config_id, generation.chunking_config_hash, generation.chunk_artifact_key, generation.chunk_artifact_checksum, generation.chunk_count, generation.status, generation.worker_token, generation.created_at, generation.updated_at FROM knowledge_index_generation generation LEFT JOIN knowledge_index_state state ON state.document_id = generation.document_id WHERE (state.active_generation_id IS NULL OR state.active_generation_id != generation.generation_id) AND ((generation.status IN (1, 2) AND generation.updated_at < #{expiredBefore}) OR (generation.status = 3 AND generation.cleanup_lease_until < #{now})) ORDER BY generation.updated_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_index_generation generation LEFT JOIN knowledge_index_state state ON state.document_id = generation.document_id SET generation.status = 3, generation.cleanup_token = #{cleanupToken}, generation.cleanup_lease_until = #{leaseUntil}, generation.updated_at = #{now} WHERE generation.generation_id = #{generationId} AND (state.active_generation_id IS NULL OR state.active_generation_id != generation.generation_id) AND ((generation.status IN (1, 2) AND generation.updated_at < #{expiredBefore}) OR (generation.status = 3 AND generation.cleanup_lease_until < #{now}))
